candidate.title: ECCITE-Seq
candidate.scope: Assigned middle ECCITE-Seq row of the Illumina poster: separate sample tagging (Cell Hashing), epitope tagging, pooling of intact cells, droplet capture and barcoding of mRNA, antibody tags and directly captured sgRNAs, followed by product separation and linked sequencing readouts. The primary-paper implementation is the 10× Genomics 5P/V(D)J system with guide capture enabled, within the broader modular ECCITE-Seq assay. Paper-supported interfaces resolve the poster capture cartoon and are explicitly recorded as corrections. The partial CITE-Seq row above, CROP-Seq row below and unrelated right-hand catalogue graphics are neighboring entries, not alternative targets of this card. Cell Hashing is an embedded component. Unpictured clonotype-enrichment branches and guide-delivery experiments are outside this extraction; the V(D)J system name does not add those branches.

method_scopes.rationale: The assigned card and middle-row heading identify only ECCITE-Seq. The source paper explicitly names and describes ECCITE-seq, including the 5-prime implementation with direct guide capture, protein tags and Cell Hashing. This graph represents the illustrated guide-enabled implementation, not a claim that all modular ECCITE-Seq experiments require all modalities. Each A/B/C sample is labeled independently before intact-cell pooling. The two labeling roles are represented together within each sample because the plus signs establish their combination but do not establish a separate temporal staining sequence. Distinct local downstream PCRs recover the short-tag classes. The V(D)J platform and Cell Hashing are components, not additional target methods. Neighboring catalogue rows and the paper’s unpictured receptor-library applications do not expand the assigned schematic.
